updates.title: Melee rotations tuned for extra attacks

lines.title: Retribution paladins twist seals whenever no Echo is waiting, not only in the last 1.5 sec before a swing
lines.note: Since extra attacks stopped resetting the swing timer, the open window puts both seals on more swings. Against Undead bosses the 1.5 sec window still does better and stays; the Holy Shock builds don't twist.

lines.title: Arms and two-hand Fury warriors use Hamstring from 10 Rage (was 30 and 20)
lines.note: More Hamstrings means more Windfury Totem and sword procs, which pay for themselves now that extra attacks keep the swing timer.

lines.title: Frost mage preset is Undead (was High Order)
lines.note: After the talent rework Undead edges out High Order on Frost.

lines.title: Efficiency also lowers Strider Kick's mana cost
Method: the Windfury Totem and extra attack answers now match the numbers (0.1 sec, the swing timer kept), and Eviscerate's 4% attack power a combo point has its own answer
lines.note: Text only: the numbers already used these since the last update.

lines.title: The raid's Sunder Armor builds up from the pull, no longer full at the pull
lines.note: A warrior tank adds a stack every global cooldown and a second warrior casts one on its first, so the boss is at 5 stacks 4.5 sec in. A warrior preset is that second warrior. It costs physical builds up to 4 DPS. Holding cooldowns for the fifth stack was tested and lost DPS, so the rotations still open with them.

lines.title: Goblin Sapper Charge and Goblin Land Mine only hit enemies within 10 yards
lines.note: The sim used them from any range. Ranged hunters still set off the Sapper when they step in to melee weave. Mages, Balance druids, Elemental shamans, warlocks and priests now take no Sapper. It costs them 4 to 9 DPS.

lines.title: Ranged hunters throw the EZ-Thro Dark Bomb instead of laying the Goblin Land Mine
lines.note: From range the mine's blast can't reach the boss, and its 1 sec cast doesn't fit in a melee weave.

lines.title: Warlocks and priests cast from 25 yards, like mages (was 5)
lines.note: That puts them out of the Sapper's reach, and their bolts now take their flight time.

lines.title: Method: the hunters' notes now say Improved Tracking counts against the generic boss, unlike Murder and the other creature-type talents
lines.note: Text only: the numbers already counted it. A hunter can track every raid boss type except Mechanical, and the talent is worth 4 to 5% to the hunters who take it.

lines.title: Hunter pets no longer have Pet Aggression (+8 damage a hit)
lines.note: No pet trainer teaches it in Forever: Beast Training doesn't list it, as in Classic, where pets never learned it. Cobra Reflexes is now about even and stays.

lines.title: Hunter pets' normal swings hit 30% less before attack power
lines.note: The game's creature damage figure already includes the pet's own attack power, and the sim was adding that attack power on top. 152 logged hits of a level 30 Cat fit the new figure.

updates.title: Launch hotfix: paladin and druid talent reworks

lines.title: Two-handed warriors' critical white hits give twice the swing's Rage (was 77% more)
lines.note: Combat logs show a two-handed white crit at exactly twice the Rage of a normal swing. The sim added the 100% bonus at the one-handed rate. One-handed and off-hand crits were already double.

lines.title: Paladin talents reworked: Unsealed Wrath replaces Twist of Light, Conviction is 2% crit a rank with everything, Holy Power only crits heals
lines.note: Unsealed Wrath stores the active seal on each landed swing (up to 3 copies) and spends them on the first swing under another seal. Seals no longer cost 20% less, and Vindication no longer raises attack power. Every paladin talent string changed.

lines.title: Retribution presets re-picked for the new trees, twisting seals through Unsealed Wrath
lines.note: Twist up 65 (974.5 to 1039.3) and sub-Holy 60 (977.9 to 1038.1), Ret Shock up 14 (960.6 to 974.9); the deep Holy Shock build drops 53 (908.4 to 855.6) and now takes a Dragonfire Potion. Undead stays the best race.

lines.title: Druid talents reworked: Berserk and Improved Shifting Power removed, Shifting Power on an 8 sec cooldown, Genesis and Naturalist 2% a point
lines.note: Predatory Discipline lets Ferocious Bite keep its extra Energy, and Bite has a new rank 1. Every druid talent string changed.

lines.title: Druid presets re-picked for the new trees
lines.note: Feral takes Furor and Blood Frenzy where Berserk was: up 57 (885.6 to 942.5). Balance and Wrath keep their talents in the new layout and gain from Genesis and Naturalist: up 45 (846.6 to 891.1) and 49 (806.5 to 855.7).

lines.title: Moonkin Aura and Leader of the Pack give 3% crit with spells and attacks, and only one of them counts
lines.note: Feral gains 0.2 from its own aura's spell crit; Balance is unchanged.

lines.title: Hunter tree: Pathfinding and Improved Revive Pet moved
lines.note: The Beast Mastery presets' Pathfinding point goes to Improved Aspect of the Monkey. No DPS change.

lines.title: Frost mage values restored: Ice Lance does 4 times damage to Frozen targets (was 3), Frigid Power 15% (was 3%), Ice Barrier 5% while shielded (was 3%), Winter's Chill 20% a stack (was 5%)
lines.note: Frostfire gains 30 on the same talents (1046.3 to 1076.6).

lines.title: Arcane Blast: 12% of Intellect, +100% mana a stack, 18 sec
lines.note: Server hotfix, not in the development notes. On its old talents and rotation Arcane lost 17.

lines.title: Frost and Arcane mage presets re-picked; Fire and Frostfire keep theirs
lines.note: Frost goes 16/4/31, keeps Ice Barrier up all fight and takes Incineration over Arcane Blast, now as High Order: up 37 (907.8 to 944.9). Arcane spends the cheaper stacks' mana on Arcane Wrath on cooldown: up 28 (910.9 to 939.0).

lines.title: The deep Holy Shock paladin build is no longer in the report, with its Judgement duty and vs Undead versions
lines.note: Ret Shock (deep Holy), 31 points in Holy to Light's Vigil, fell 17.7% behind Ret twist with the talent rework (855.6 at 180 s). Ret Shock, Holy Shock with most points in Retribution, stays.

lines.title: Frostfire is the mage's default build, in place of Fire
lines.note: Frostfire does 1076.6 at 180 s against Fire's 1056.4. Fire stays a preset.

lines.title: Marksmanship and Lone Wolf cast Aimed Shot again while mana is above 40%
lines.note: Below 40% mana Multi-Shot takes the shared cooldown, as before. Up 2 to 3 at 180 s (Marksmanship 1063.7 to 1066.4, Lone Wolf 1087.4 to 1090.0), 6 to 8 at 120 s, even at 300 s. Survival and Beast Mastery keep their rotations.

lines.title: Lightning Overload's extra bolts no longer trigger Judgement of Wisdom or Elemental Devastation
lines.note: The extra bolt counts as a proc in the game data, and those effects don't fire from procs, as with Fire Nova. Elemental loses a little mana from Judgement of Wisdom: 768.5 to 768.4 at 180 s, 753.2 to 752.8 with Mana Tide.

lines.title: Two-hand Fury uses Berserker Rage only under 10 Rage and Slams from 60 Rage
lines.note: Was under 30 and from 45. Berserker Rage's global cooldown goes to a Hamstring instead, and with the bigger crit Rage Slam's swing delay is needed less often. About +5 at every length (1078.2 to 1083.9 at 120 s on the base build).

lines.title: Dual-wield Fury drinks its pull Mighty Rage Potion only when a second one fits
lines.note: In a fight under about 135 s the pull potion's 2 min cooldown cost the one with Death Wish and Recklessness. Up 1 to 2 at 120 s, the same at 180 and 300 s.

lines.title: Arms on Sunder duty Slams ahead of Mortal Strike
lines.note: The duty's Sunders take global cooldowns, and a wait costs Slam's 15 s cooldown more than Mortal Strike's 6 s. Up about 2 at every length (968.0 to 970.4 at 180 s).

lines.title: Rogues use their builders whenever they can afford them, without timing them after a swing
lines.note: Forever's extra attacks don't reset the swing timer, so a proc's free swing is the same wherever the builder lands, and waiting only delays it. At 180 s: Combat Swords 777.0 to 782.1, Seal Fate Swords 743.2 to 747.1, Combat Daggers 788.9 to 790.8, Seal Fate Daggers 751.4 to 752.9, Mutilate 742.7 to 743.8, Subtlety 732.1 to 732.9. Every build stays Undead.

lines.title: Combat Daggers stops pooling Energy, drops Vanish into Ambush and Preparation, and refreshes Slice and Dice in its last second
lines.note: Part of its gain above. Seal Fate Daggers keeps the Vanish and the 3 sec refresh, now as its own rotation.

lines.title: Demonology wears a gear set of its own, built for its own stat target
lines.note: It wore the Destruction and Affliction set, which is short of the crit a Demonology warlock gears for. Up 7.2 at 180 s (1045.5 to 1052.7). Orc stays its best race.

lines.title: Casters stand at the longest range all of their spells reach
lines.note: Distance sets how long every bolt flies. Frostfire and Arcane stand at 20 yd for Fire Blast, Shadow at 22 for Mind Flay, Fire, Frost, Smite and the warlocks at 30, Balance at 36 with Nature's Reach; Elemental stays at 20. Most builds move by under 2 DPS at 180 s. Balance Wrath loses about 7, since a Wrath now flies longer than it casts, and Arcane no longer ends on Arcane Explosion.

lines.title: Balance Wrath is a Night Elf
lines.note: At 36 yd haste shortens the cast but not the flight, so the Skyborne races fall behind: Night Elf 853.0 against Windshaper's 848.3 at 180 s. It holds Elune's Light for the trinket, as Balance does. Windshaper stays the best Horde race.

lines.title: Beast Mastery hunters start the fight at 12 yd
lines.note: Just outside Auto Shot's dead zone, where the weave starts anyway. Up 1.5 at 180 s (1045.4 to 1046.9). Marksmanship and Lone Wolf gain nothing from it and stay at 25 yd.

lines.title: Ice Lance and Fire Blast share a cooldown
lines.note: The game files put Ice Lance's 8 sec cooldown in the same category as Fire Blast's, so casting either puts both on cooldown. Frostfire, the one preset that casts both, drops 11.7 at 180 s (1076.0 to 1064.3).

lines.title: Ranged hunters no longer carry the Goblin Sapper Charge
lines.note: It only goes off within 10 yd, which a ranged hunter reaches only mid-weave. Down 0.1 to 0.4 at 180 s. Survival keeps it.

lines.title: Affliction is an Orc
lines.note: Orc 1013.6 against Human's 1012.7 at 180 s. Human stays the best Alliance race.

lines.title: Warlocks time their second Bane of Doom for the 2 minute cooldowns
lines.note: Bane of Doom deals its damage in one tick a minute later, on the stats the warlock has when it lands. Holding the second Doom one second past its cooldown makes that tick land after the trinket and Blood Fury come back. Up 0.6 to 2.2 at 180 s. The curse duty presets already cast it late enough.

lines.note: Chain Lightning still stays out of the single-target rotations, so no shaman number moves.

lines.title: Rogue server hotfix: Shank always hits and no longer procs poisons or weapon effects, Mutilate's flat damage raised to 44 / 63 / 88, Venom's extra poison chance covers only Deadly and Wound Poison, talent tree layout updated
lines.note: Improved Distract is gone and several talents moved column; Quick Getaway now needs Dirty Tricks, so Subtlety's point moves there. The poisons' charges went up too, which moves no number. At 180 s: Combat Swords 963.5 to 958.6, Seal Fate Swords 957.0 to 940.4, Combat Daggers 946.7 to 949.8, Seal Fate Daggers 920.7 to 903.4, Subtlety 881.7 to 881.3, Mutilate 866.1 to 858.3.

lines.title: Presets regeared to the hit that sims best: specs with hit from talents trade the gear hit they no longer need for other stats, dual wielders carry extra hit for their white swings
lines.note: Each step swaps 1% hit rating for other stats at the same item budget, and each preset keeps the step that sims best. Feral cat takes Nature's Reach 2 in place of Natural Shapeshifter and drops 4% hit from its gear (+26 at 180 s); the Retribution builds with Precision drop 3% (+11 to +12); Arcane mage drops 1% (+7); Enhancement drops 3 or 4% with a point or two moved, such as Tidal Focus 3 (+5 to +7); Fire Destruction drops 1% for Suppression 4 and Aftermath 5 (+1). Rogues carry 2 or 3% more hit (+4 to +6) and dual-wield Fury 2% more (+2 to +3).

lines.title: Dwarves trade Artisan's Precision's spare hit through the same gear steps
lines.note: On presets that sit on the hit cap, a Dwarf wears the gear one step lower in hit, real item stats in place of the bonus stats it got before; Seal Fate rogues take a step less of their extra hit. Every other race keeps the preset's hit, so only the Dwarf's gear changes. Worth about 1 to 8 DPS on the presets it applies to.

lines.title: Warrior server hotfix: Spearing Strike deals 75% weapon damage (was 40%) and 150% against Giants and Dragonkin (was 120%), Raging Blows replaced by Improved Whirlwind, Reckless Swings on a 1 sec global cooldown
lines.note: Cleave and Whirlwind lose Raging Blows' 3 Rage discount, and its point is free. Reckless Swings costs 25% of base health, which moves no preset's damage. Slam's 15 sec cooldown, Improved Slam, Flurry, Two-Handed Weapon Specialization, Improved Tactical Mastery and Bloodthrill take the values the development notes gave. The talent tree layout changed, so every warrior talent string changed. At 180 s on the old rotations: Fury 1153.0 to 1127.9, two-hand Fury 1173.3 to 1134.3, Arms 1097.7 to 1075.8, Arms vs Dragonkin 1142.2 to 1133.7.

lines.title: Warriors cast Reckless Swings below the main strikes now that it takes a global cooldown; dual-wield Fury puts the freed point in Improved Bloodrage, two-hand Fury in Booming Voice
lines.note: Two-hand Fury, its duty builds, Arms and Arms with Battle Shout cast it only under 20 Rage. Orc stays the best race on every warrior build. At 180 s, with the hotfix above: Fury 1136.0, two-hand Fury 1151.0, Arms 1088.0, Arms vs Dragonkin 1147.0.

lines.title: Unbridled Wrath procs only on white swings, not on Heroic Strike or Cleave
lines.note: Its proc type is the melee auto attack. A queued Heroic Strike or Cleave takes the swing's place but is a special attack, so it no longer gives Unbridled Wrath's Rage. A little less Rage for every warrior preset.

lines.title: Divine Favor costs its full 4% of base mana; Benediction doesn't lower it
lines.note: Ret Shock casts it. Divine Favor carries no class flags, so Benediction's cost cut can't reach it. A fraction of a DPS.

lines.title: Every preset re-simmed with a separate random stream for each kind of roll
lines.note: Two sims that differ in one setting now share every other roll, so race, racial and assumption comparisons are about three times as precise for the same number of fights. Every number moves by about its error.

lines.title: Race, racial and assumption comparisons sim as many fights as they need for a set precision
lines.note: Each comparison sims a first batch, measures how much it varies against what it is compared with, and tops both sides up to the fights it needs, up to 40,000: 0.35 DPS between two races, about 10% of a racial's or a target type's worth, about 5% of an assumption's effect. Race ties use that precision. The presets' own numbers don't change.

lines.title: New warrior assumption shown: only white swings that land use a Reckless Swings charge
lines.note: The game data says white swings use its 4 charges, but whether a miss, dodge or parry uses one is decided by the server. If it did, dual-wield Fury would lose about 2.6 DPS; the two-handed builds miss too rarely to lose any.

lines.title: Ret twist is the paladin's default build, in place of sub-Holy
lines.note: With its gear trading hit for other stats it is now the paladin's highest build at every fight length.

lines.title: Survival hunter takes Rapid Killing in place of a point of Resourcefulness
lines.note: One more Rapid Fire in a 5 minute fight; no change at 2 and 3 minutes.

lines.title: Feral cats use the Goblin Sapper Charge
lines.note: Goblin Sapper Charge and Goblin Land Mine work in Cat and Bear Form (the game's own item data allows them in a form), so the Feral cat presets now take the sapper.

lines.title: Ferocious Bite gains more from extra Energy
lines.note: Hotfix 113403 raised Ferocious Bite's damage per point of extra Energy on every rank (top rank 2.7 to 3.3).

lines.title: Gear tables name the right enchant when two slots' enchants share an effect
lines.note: A bracer with Superior Stamina showed as Shield - Greater Stamina, and Greater Agility gloves as boots. Labels only; the sims always used the right stats.

source.label: Blizzard: WoW Forever Beta Development Notes, updated November 2

lines.title: Stormstrike deals 100% weapon damage (was 150%) and has an 8 sec cooldown (was 6)
lines.note: No server data carries it yet, so the sim takes the announced values.

lines.title: Mental Dexterity gives 33 / 66 / 100% of Intellect as attack power (was 50 / 100 / 150%)
lines.note: Every Enhancement build takes 3/3, so Intellect is worth a third less to it.

lines.title: Maelstrom Weapon procs 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10 times a minute by rank, and every stack takes 20% off cast time and mana at every rank
lines.note: A chance per swing by main-hand speed: about 60% a landed hit with a 3.6 speed weapon at 5/5. Before it, every landed melee hit gave a stack, as our combat logs of November 8 and 9 showed, and the sim did that. No server data carries the new rate yet.

lines.title: Weapon imbues and weapon totems work together: Windfury Weapon and Windfury Totem can both proc
lines.note: Before, Windfury Weapon on the main hand turned off the shaman's own benefit from Windfury Totem, and Flametongue Weapon the same for Flametongue Totem. Blizzard doesn't say whether the two Windfury procs share a cooldown, so each keeps its own (an assumption on the Assumptions tab). Every Enhancement build now gets both from its own Windfury Totem.

lines.title: Windfury Totem and Flametongue Totem replace each other: the last one placed takes hold
lines.note: A weapon holds one totem buff, so the Enhancement builds no longer get the raid's Flametongue Totem next to their own Windfury Totem.

lines.title: Stormstrike's mark lands after Stormstrike's own damage
lines.note: So Stormstrike doesn't raise its own damage, which matches our combat logs.

lines.title: Spell damage rolls in whole points, as the game does
lines.note: A fraction of a point at most; only the shaman builds are re-simmed with it so far.

lines.title: Enhancement talents and rotations re-searched
lines.note: Level 60 and Improved Ghost Wolf move Convection to Reverberation, Water Shield moves an Elemental Devastation point to Call of Flame, and the Mana Tide rotation changes. Every build keeps Windfury Weapon with its own Windfury Totem: Flametongue Weapon is 93 to 100 behind at 180 s, Flametongue Totem in Windfury Totem's place 110 to 120. With the hotfixes above, every Enhancement build is down 131 to 142 at 180 s, from first among the shaman builds to below Elemental Level 60 on Mana Tide.

lines.title: Dwarf gear for the new Enhancement builds
lines.note: The Dwarf's extra 1% hit is traded for other stats only where that still gains: on Improved Ghost Wolf (+1.6 at 180 s), no longer on Level 60.

lines.title: Minor Health and Minor Stamina enchants take the Forever client values
lines.note: Minor Health is +2 Stamina (was +5 health) and Minor Stamina +3 Stamina (was +1). No damage moves.

lines.title: Rage of the Storm: 16 Strength, 102 to 154 damage at 3.60 speed
lines.note: A leveling weapon; no level 60 preset wears it.

lines.title: Wrack deals 30% less damage and no longer increases your damage over time effects; while you channel it, Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony tick twice as fast
lines.note: The damage over time effects keep their total duration, so they tick more often.

lines.title: Soul Siphon counts only Corruption, Siphon Life and Bane of Agony
Affliction keeps Bane of Agony up instead of Bane of Doom, recasts Corruption just before it falls off, and channels Wrack whenever nothing else is due
Imp Firebolt rank 1 deals 6 to 8 damage
lines.note: A leveling rank; no level 60 build changes.

lines.title: Arcane Shot and Summon Hawk cost 11% of base mana at every rank
The hawk from Summon Hawk deals about 80% more melee damage
lines.note: No server data carries it yet, so the sim takes the announced value. The hawk still trails Arcane Shot on the cooldown they share, so no build takes it.

lines.title: Arcane Concentration's chance is shared across the Arcane Missiles cast and its missiles, about 10% a channel in all
lines.note: Before, every missile rolled the full chance. Blizzard's wording allows another reading; the sim takes the split one.

lines.title: Nature's Swiftness also makes Wild Growth instant
lines.note: Healing only; no damage build changes.

lines.title: Idol of Ferocity takes 2 energy off Claw and Rake (was 3)
lines.note: No build wears it.

lines.title: Sweeping Strikes no longer uses a charge on a hit with no second target
lines.note: Only fights with more than one target change.

lines.title: Sparklance Wand deals Arcane damage
lines.note: No build uses it.

lines.title: Earthen Silk Slippers give +17 healing and +6 spell damage (was +18 spell power)
lines.note: No build wears them.

lines.title: Enchant Bracer and Boots - Lesser Spirit give +4 Spirit (was resistance to all schools)
lines.note: No build uses them.

lines.title: Item data refreshed from Wowhead's Forever listing; Blackhand's Breadth gives 1% crit (was 2%)
lines.note: No report build wears the changed items.

lines.title: Sim fix: a damage over time effect no longer ticks once more after it has run out
lines.note: It happened when Wrack's faster ticks or a Deadly Poison refresh moved the last tick past the effect's end. Affliction loses about 6 DPS; rogues move by under 0.5.

lines.title: Windfury Totem procs from white main hand swings and from the main hand attacks that use the weapon, not from every special attack
lines.note: Our combat logs show thousands of totem procs. Heroic Strike, Cleave, Raptor Strike, Sunder Armor, Revenge, Execute and Sinister Strike roll it; Stormstrike (none in 4,467 hits), Holy Strike, Bloodthirst, Whirlwind and Feral attacks never do. Off-hand swings, seal procs and Judgements don't either.

lines.title: Natural flasks give 30 Stamina (was 60), and their zone bonus is 2% (was 4 or 5%)
lines.note: The report's fights take place in the flasks' zones, so the Aggression flask's crit drops from 4% to 2%. Physical builds lose about 15 to 40 DPS.

lines.title: The Chief's Enforcer's Farraki Enforcement proc, at the rate seen in our logs
lines.note: No build wears it.

lines.title: Item data: items seen in game and newly revealed on Forever
lines.note: Hundreds of items added or corrected, among them Edgemaster's Handguards, Shriveled Heart and the Royal Seals of Eldre'Thalas. No report build wears a changed item.

lines.title: Downranked damage spells deal their full damage; the low-rank penalty applies to heals only
lines.note: Our logs show low-rank Lightning Bolt and Fire Nova at their full coefficient. No damage preset downranks.

lines.title: Orc shaman base attributes at levels 2 to 43 from the character sheet
lines.note: Leveling only; level 60 is unchanged.

lines.title: Each class's default build is now its highest at 3 minutes: dual wield Fury, Combat Daggers, Affliction and Lone Wolf
lines.note: They take the place of two-hand Fury, Combat Swords, Destruction and Beast Mastery as the build each class page opens on. No number changes.

lines.title: Venom's extra 20% chance to apply poisons now reaches Instant Poison as well as Deadly and Wound Poison
lines.note: The November 3 hotfix's chance row also names Instant Poison's spell group; the sim had left it out. Builds that use Venom (Seal Fate and Mutilate) gain a little.

lines.title: Rake's initial hit now adds 6.5% of attack power
lines.note: A combat log shows Rake's initial hit growing with attack power; the sim had given it none. Feral builds that use Rake gain a little.

lines.title: Hunter pets attack faster with their hunter's melee haste, such as Rapid Fire
lines.note: In combat logs a pet swings 40% faster while its hunter's Rapid Fire is up, and its own Frenzy speeds it up on top of that. The hunter's ranged haste, such as Quick Shots, doesn't reach it. Pets gain about 2 to 10 DPS on Beast Mastery and Marksmanship and about 27 on Survival.

lines.title: Hunter pets use the next ability on their bar when one is short of focus, instead of saving up for it
lines.note: As autocast does in game. Worth about 3 pet DPS.

lines.title: Judgement is a ranged attack: it rolls on the ranged attack table, and melee procs no longer see it
lines.note: From the November 11 hotfixes: Judgement of Command, Righteousness and Fury now roll as ranged attacks, so effects that trigger on melee hits no longer fire from them. Threat is unchanged. Retribution builds lose 0.5 to 0.7%; Protection paladins move too (see the Tanking tab).

lines.title: Survival uses Wing Clip on every free global cooldown, with no mana floor
lines.note: Wing Clip rolls Windfury Totem, so it is worth casting even at low mana. Survival gains about 1 DPS at 3 minutes and more in longer fights.

lines.title: Fury on Battle Shout duty fills gaps closer to Bloodthirst and Whirlwind and uses Heroic Strike from 60 Rage during Reckless Swings
lines.note: Heroic Strike and Hamstring wait until Bloodthirst and Whirlwind are at least 1 sec away. Worth about 5 DPS.

lines.title: Combat Swords is the Rogue's default build again
lines.note: With Windfury Totem on main hand attacks it is the Rogue's highest build at 3 minutes, ahead of Combat Daggers. No number moves; only the build a Rogue opens on.

lines.title: Tanking: every tank's enchants re-picked slot by slot
lines.note: Each tank preset takes the best Phase 1 enchant for each slot at its own goal: Greater Agility boots for the Warrior and Warden, Strength wrists for the Warrior, an Agility cloak for the Warden, and for the Paladin Agility, Holy Power gloves, spell power wrists and a spell power or Agility neck. The Protection Paladin is now 1st at Max survival (1811 against the Warrior's 1776), and gains about 95 at Max threat and 85 at Balanced. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Tanking: flasks and consumables re-picked for each tank's goal, raid-only consumables left out
lines.note: Flask of the Titans at Max survival for the Warrior, Bear and Warden (and Warden Balanced), Flask of Supreme Power for the Paladin at Max survival, Wizard Oil for the Paladin. The Warrior's Dense Sharpening Stone and the Warden's Greater Mageblood Elixir come out, since a tank can't count on them outside a raid. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Tanking: the Bear at Max survival is a Tauren with Feral Instinct and leans on Frenzied Regeneration
lines.note: Tauren replaces Night Elf. Frenzied Regeneration and Swipe at 80 Rage, Barkskin from 20 sec in at Max threat. The Bear's Max survival score goes from -297 to 262. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Tanking: Warden totems re-tuned, and the Warrior keeps Shield Wall for the last 13 sec at Max survival
lines.note: The Warden at Max threat keeps Searing Totem and Fire Nova up all fight on new talents; Balanced and Max survival drop Healing Stream Totem. The Warden scores 2562 at Max threat (was 2,496) and 1224 at Balanced (was 1,125). No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Healing: Restoration Druids cast Nature's Swiftness on its own, and take Heart of the Wild
lines.note: Nature's Swiftness now also makes Wild Growth instant, so the Druid saves it for an instant Regrowth when someone drops under 45% (raid) or an instant Healing Touch when the tank drops under 45% (tank). Subtlety's points go to Heart of the Wild. Raid carry 1.391 to 1.414, tank carry 1.235 to 1.269. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Healing: the Holy Priest raid healer takes Twilight Focus, the Holy Paladin raid healer leads with Flash of Light
lines.note: The raid Holy Priest moves Inspiration's 3 points to Twilight Focus; the tank healer keeps Inspiration. The raid Holy Paladin drops the top Holy Light ranks and Divine Favor for Flash of Light on the most hurt. Carry: Holy Priest 1.437 to 1.461, Holy Paladin 1.413 to 1.430. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Healing: the Restoration Shaman raid healer saves Nature's Swiftness for an instant Healing Wave
lines.note: Used when someone in the group drops under 65%. Raid carry 1.395 to 1.412. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Healing: every healer takes Greater Cleric's Elixir, Phase 1 food and an oil it can buy
lines.note: Greater Cleric's Elixir replaces Greater Arcane Elixir, whose spell damage heals nothing. Food is Wicked Smoothie for the Druid and Runn Tum Tuber Surprise for the rest; oils are Wizard Oil, or Lesser Mana Oil for the raid and Holy tank Paladin. Flask of Supreme Power stays. No damage preset changes.

lines.title: Healers' Most Hurt and Lowest Health checks read the health the healer has seen
lines.note: Current Health checks now read the same delayed health the healer picks its target by, and count a target as full when nobody is left to heal. It moves healer results a little. No damage preset changes.
